review_candidates.description: Position Overview We are seeking a Director of Commissioning to lead and scale a high-performing commissioning practice across complex commercial, institutional, and industrial building projects. The Director of Commissioning will establish program strategy, ensure quality delivery of commissioning and retro-commissioning services, and serve as the principal technical authority for HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and building automation systems. This role requires a strategic leader who combines deep technical expertise (TAB, testing and balancing, controls, BMS) with strong client, construction, and commercial acumen to deliver assured system performance, energy optimization, and code compliance. Key Responsibilities Provide leadership and direction for the commissioning organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing commissioning engineers, TAB specialists, and controls technicians. Define and implement commissioning standards, procedures, protocols, and quality assurance programs consistent with NEBB, BCxA, ASHRAE, and client requirements. Oversee planning and execution of commissioning, retro-commissioning, and continuous commissioning projects across mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems. Develop and manage project budgets, staffing plans, schedules, and commercial terms to ensure profitable, on-time delivery. Serve as the technical lead for complex system acceptance testing, testing and balancing (TAB), functional performance testing, controls sequence verification, and integrated systems verification. Collaborate with owners, design teams, general contractors, subcontractors, and facility operations to define project requirements, resolve technical issues, and ensure seamless turnover. Review and approve commissioning plans, test procedures, final reports, deficiency logs, and systems documentation; ensure rigorous documentation and close-out processes. Champion continuous improvement by analyzing commissioning outcomes, delivering lessons learned, and implementing process and tool enhancements to improve quality and efficiency. Represent the organization in client meetings, design reviews, value engineering sessions, and industry forums; promote commissioning benefits and best practices to stakeholders. Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, certifications, and safety requirements; lead risk management and site safety coordination related to commissioning activities. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Systems Engineering or related technical discipline; Masters degree preferred. Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred. Minimum 8 years of progressive commissioning, engineering, or construction experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or program management role. Demonstrated technical expertise in commissioning, HVAC, mechanical systems, plumbing, electrical systems, controls, building automation systems (BAS/BMS), and testing & balancing (TAB). Certifications and familiarity with industry standards such as BCxA, NEBB, ACG (or equivalent), ASHRAE guidelines, and commissioning certifications preferred. Proven track record of delivering complex commercial or institutional projects, including experience with energy optimization, functional performance testing, and fault detection & diagnostics. Strong commercial skills including budgeting, proposal development, contract negotiation, and client relationship management. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to advocate for commissioning value to owners and design/construction teams. Proficiency with commissioning software, sequence of operations development, controls programming review, and data analysis tools; hands-on experience with TAB procedures. Willingness to travel to project sites and ability to work in construction and occupied building environments as required. review_candidates.description: Company Name: SAJIDA FOUNDATION Location: Dhaka Job Type: Full-Time Workplace Type: Full time Job ID: IJOB202676414 SAJIDA Foundation is a value-driven non-government organisation that embodies the principle of corporate philanthropy, with 51% shareholding of Renata Ltd., a leading pharmaceutical company in Bangladesh. Founded in 1993, SAJIDA aims to deliver meaningful and sustainable change in the lives of people from all strata, through a portfolio comprising of financial products and services, community centric development programmes and specialised social enterprises. Going forward, SAJIDA will invest to pilot and scale evidence-based initiatives, develop partnerships and continue to set up specialised subsidiaries including an independent research institute in the foreseeable future. Reporting to the CEO of the organisation, the Director of SAJIDA Research and Evaluation Department should be a top-notch organisation builder with experience in management and excellent track record of research and publications in the areas of social development and health. Department: Research & Evaluation Position type: Full time Job Location: Head Office Reports to: Chief Executive Officer Contract type: This will be a full-time position based in Dhaka with a minimum commitment of two years. The Role: The Director will define strategy and set the goals of SAJIDA's Research and Evaluation Department in consultation with SAJIDA's senior management and other key stakeholders in fulfilling SAJIDA Foundation's vision and mission. Beginning with consolidation of existing research within SAJIDA Foundation and forming an in-house entity, the long-term goal is to establish a world class research institution under the umbrella of the Foundation. Leadership & Organisational Development Contribute to the vision and strategic plan for Research and Evaluation unit to achieve SAJIDA Foundation's short and long-term goals; Lead the development of the multi-disciplinary research department under the guidance of the advisory group of the department; Represent the foundation nationally and internationally; Form and lead a strong and cohesive team of researchers to carry out the Foundation's research agenda; Initiate research training programs for capacity building, both in house and external; Develop mechanisms to work in collaboration with programs in a manner that the objectivity of research and their findings is ensured through use of rigorous research methods and by maintaining research integrity.
